item.title: Federal records find 165 noncitizens registered to vote in Indiana
item.description: Indiana officials say they've reached a landmark settlement with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security to modernize citizenship verification tools for voting. Federal records show that at least 165 noncitizens registered to vote in Indiana, with 21 casting ballots in recent elections.

item.title: Appeal for Delphi murderer Richard Allen could be filed by next week
item.description: Delphi murderer Richard M. Allen's attorneys on Monday filed a motion seeking seven more days to complete their appeal, citing the complexity and volume of the case materials and numerous constitutional issues involved.

item.title: Indiana man dies rescuing dog from icy pond
item.description: A 69-year-old Syracuse man died after falling through the ice while trying to rescue his dog from a pond in Elkhart County, Indiana.

item.title: Couple die when their buggy collides with dump truck near Shipshewana
item.description: Near Shipshewana, Indiana, Marvin and Ruby Shrock were killed in a crash involving a commercial truck and their Amish buggy on Tuesday afternoon on U.S. 20 near LaGrange County Road 1000 West, Indiana State Police say.

item.title: Republican senator against Indiana redistricting won’t seek reelection
item.description: Republican state Sen. Kyle Walker announced that he will not seek reelection in 2026, joining a dozen other GOP senators who oppose the proposed GOP-redraw of Indiana's congressional maps.

item.title: Bitter cold weather to force Carmel Christkindlmarkt closure
item.description: Carmel Christkindlmarkt will be closed Thursday, Dec. 4, 2025, due to dangerously cold weather. Storm Track 8 expects temperatures to drop as low 17 on Thursday evening, and single digits by Friday morning.

item.title: Upgrade your holiday baking with Consumer Reports’ top-rated appliances
item.description: Consumer Reports has released its list of top-tested kitchen helpers for holiday baking, including stand mixers, hand mixers, food processors, and toaster ovens, with budget-friendly options available for all appliances.

item.title: Man fatally shot at south side apartments near Hanna Avenue, Meridian Street
item.description: A man was fatally shot in the 4200 block of Burkhart Drive in Indianapolis early Monday morning, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department.

item.title: Indianapolis gears up for Big Ten football championship, Fan Fest
item.description: The Big Ten Fan Fest will be in downtown Indianapolis from Friday to Saturday, featuring entertainment, games, performances, giveaways, virtual reality games, IndyCar cars, food, and a wing-eating competition. Times and ticket details in story.

item.title: Cold front brings bitter wind chills to Indiana, temperatures plummet | Dec. 4, 2025
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Patchy freezing fog and isolated light snow this Thursday morning, with temperatures struggling to reach the low 20s. Today: A cold front moving through northwest Indiana is expected to clear the fog and low clouds, while high pressure will bring much colder conditions throughout the day and night.
